name: kotha-studio
description: Monochrome blueprint-to-3D interior planning and furniture ordering platform.
author: Prajwal Basnet

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c gray,white "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kotha/shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
